About the society

Rooted in devotion.
Dedicated to service.

Matha Sree Mandiram Charitable Society is a non-profit society formed to support religious and spiritual activities, cultural preservation, education and charitable service. Its stated objectives include serving people without discrimination of caste, creed or religion.

“Let devotion inspire service, and let service strengthen our community.”

Our purpose

A mission with many ways to serve

The society's memorandum describes the following religious, cultural, educational and community-welfare objectives.

🛕

Religious & Spiritual

Establish, maintain and manage Matha Sree Mandiram and other religious places; conduct poojas, homams, bhajans and spiritual discourses.

🎉

Cultural Promotion

Promote and preserve Indian culture, traditions and heritage, and celebrate festivals such as Navaratri, Sankranti, Sri Rama Navami and Shivaratri.

🍚

Annadanam & Seva

Provide free food, prasadam and drinking water to devotees and needy people.

📚

Education

Support Vedic schools, yoga classes, sloka classes and moral-value education for children and youth.

🤝

Charitable Activities

Help poor people, orphans, widows and senior citizens through medical aid, education support and financial assistance.

🌱

Social Welfare

Conduct blood donation camps, health camps, tree plantation and cleanliness drives.

🏛️

Temple Maintenance

Collect donations and maintain temple infrastructure, renovation and development works.

👩‍🎓

Women & Youth Empowerment

Conduct skill-development programmes and self-help groups for women and youth.

🕊️

Harmony & Community

Promote religious harmony, spiritual growth and community welfare through inclusive service.
